item.title: PCSO announces lotto draw schedule this Christmas 2025, New Year
item.description: MANILA, Philippines – The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced the schedule of selling and actual lotto draws for the 2025 Christmas season. Monitor here the winning numbers for 6/45, 6/55, EZ2 (2D Lotto), Swertres (3D lotto), and 4D Lotto. PCSO said jackpot prize for the evening major draws – Mega Lotto 6/45 and Grand Lotto 6/55 – now hitting Php 13.5 million and Php 249 million, respectively.
